Package com.example.impact.controller

Class UserController

java.lang.Object
com.example.impact.controller.UserController
public class UserController extends Object
Coordinates user-related operations between the UI and EntrantDb/AdminDb.

The controller validates inputs and delegates Firestore access to the role utilities.
